Simply apply with CV and we will get in touch with you!

The first weeks will be marked by a solid familiarisation period with various training sessions to learn all the tricks of the trade.

- Packing goods according to applicable guidelines and safety regulations.

- Ensuring strict quality controls to ensure our products meet the highest standards.
- Performing various other tasks according to team and customer needs.

What do we ask of you?

- Are you flexibly deployable for various tasks;
- Do you have a good command of the English language, as all our work instructions are in English;
- As a team player with a proactive attitude, you bring a positive atmosphere with you.
- Available 40h a week (working hours 9.00-18.00), overtime may occur; We complete orders to allow all scheduled operations to go ahead
